hero.title: Hand drawn
hero.intro: Wobbly, hand-drawn React containers, notes and headers. Everything below is themed through --hd-* CSS variables, so try the theme button.

default.title: Sample note
default.text: Wobbly outline, hand-placed tilt, same seed every render.

playground.title: Play with me
playground.text: Hover this card to see the effect.

paper.text: Lines and patterns follow the theme colours.

howToUse.title: How to use
howToUse.note: Install, import the CSS once, then use the components. Theming is plain CSS variables.

playground.title: Playground
playground.note: Mix a preset with hover, entrance and idle motion. Changing a dropdown remounts the card so entrances replay.

headers.title: Headers
headers.note: Hover the ones with animate="hover" to watch them redraw.

presets.title: Presets
presets.note: Every key in SKETCH_PRESETS, rendered from the object itself, so new presets appear automatically.
presets.label: preset="{name}"

paper.title: Paper
paper.note: The paper prop sets the sheet behind a card. Use paper="none" for no sheet.
paper.label: paper="{name}"

fills.title: Fills
fills.note: backgroundColor takes a token name or any CSS colour. isTransparent turns the fill into a light tint.

tapePins.title: Tape and pins
tapePins.note: Colours come from the same tokens, so they follow the theme.

hover.title: Hover effects
hover.note: The outline also redraws on hover when animate="hover" is set. Combine both for the full effect.
hover.label: hover="{name}" animate="hover"

entrances.title: Entrances
entrances.note: Play once when the card mounts, staggered with enterDelay.
entrances.label: enter="{name}" enterDelay={{delay}}

idle.title: Idle motion
idle.note: Slow loops for things that should feel alive. Use sparingly on a busy page.

wobble.title: Wobble tuning
wobble.note: roughness, passes and tilt pass straight through to the container.

css: // main.jsx, or app/layout.jsx in Next.js. Import once.
motion: hover="lift"         // lift | press | grow | tilt | wiggle
animate="hover"      // outline redraws on hover ("boil" = always)
theme: /* Any CSS file. Import order doesn't matter. */
/* Or map your own design system onto the lib */
/* Or scope it to one section */
dark: <html data-hd-theme="dark">   <!-- or "light". No attribute = follow the OS -->
fonts: /* Point the font tokens at whatever fonts you load */

blocks.text: It holds the theme variables, patterns and motion classes.
It looks right with no setup. Pass a `seed` to keep the wobble stable between renders.
Use either `enter` or `idle` on one card, not both. Everything respects prefers-reduced-motion.
The lib only reads `--hd-*` variables: `ink`, `paper`, `paper-2`, `accent`, `accent-2`, `highlight` and `shadow`. Try the theme button above to see them switch.
The lib never downloads fonts. Load your own, then point the two tokens at them.

props.name: preset
props.what: Starting look. Any key of SKETCH_PRESETS.

props.name: paper
props.values: lined, grid, dotted, plain, aged, none

props.name: backgroundColor
props.values: token name or any CSS colour

props.name: isTransparent
props.what: Turns the fill into a light tint.

props.name: hover
props.values: lift, press, grow, tilt, wiggle, none

props.name: enter / enterDelay
props.what: Entrance animation and its delay in ms.

props.name: drawIn
props.what: Outline draws itself in on mount.

props.name: roughness / passes
props.what: How wobbly, and how many strokes.

props.name: seed
props.what: Fixes the wobble so it is the same every render.
